scenes.headline: Stop: 4 points. Loss: 7.
scenes.say: Your stop was four points away. You lost seven.

scenes.headline: 08:30. The data hits.
scenes.say: Eight thirty data. Price jumps straight past your stop.

scenes.headline: Your stop fills here.
scenes.say: A triggered stop is a market order. It fills at the next price.

scenes.title: Would you hold through 8:30?
scenes.sub: Comment below. Send it to the friend who does.
scenes.say: Would you hold through eight thirty? Yes or no, comment below.

post.instagram:
Long at 5,004.00, stop at 5,000.00: 4 points of planned risk. At 08:30 economic data came out and the next trade printed at 4,997.00. A stop becomes a market order when triggered, so it filled there: 3 points of slippage, 7 points lost. Would you hold a trade through 8:30 data? Yes or no in the comments.

Save this for later and follow @calmedgeofficial for one trading concept a day.
